title: Add HTML user list and post list pages to FastAPI monolith
description: Brownfield Python task: extend the FastAPI monolith with two HTML-returning endpoints using HTMLResponse. No template engine required — build HTML strings inline.

task_spec.prompt:
Add two HTML-rendering endpoints to src/app.py. All existing tests must still pass. Import and use: from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse 1. GET /users/ui — returns HTMLResponse (status 200) — HTML contains an

Users

heading — for each user: a
containing the user id and username — if no users, show

No users found.

2. GET /posts/ui — returns HTMLResponse (status 200) — HTML contains an

Posts

heading — for each post: a
containing the post id and title — if no posts, show

No posts found.

Build HTML as a plain Python string — no Jinja2 or template files required. IMPORTANT: FastAPI route ordering matters. Define /users/ui and /posts/ui BEFORE /users/{user_id} and /posts/{post_id} — otherwise FastAPI will match 'ui' as the path param and return 422 instead of serving the HTML endpoint. All existing tests must still pass. Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: GET /users/ui contains user id and username in HTML
GET /posts/ui contains post id and title in HTML
success_criteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
